summary: Apollo Commercial Real Estate Finance (ARI) filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026 disclosing it indefinitely suspended its Direct Stock Purchase and Dividend Reinvestment Plan effective September 29, 2026; the plan may later be terminated. Consequent to the suspension, all future dividends will be paid in cash rather than reinvested. Final direct stock purchases occur September 28, 2026, with the last recurring ACH debit September 25; Equiniti Trust Company returns funds received on or after September 28. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or price terms were stated. Watch cash-flow and buyback implications.
